entries.averment: Rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle is pleaded expressly (the jurisdictional averment).
The compensation claimed equals the figure recomputed by the Tribunal-approved multiplier method.

source.ref: Sarla Verma v. DTC; National Insurance v. Pranay Sethi

entries.averment: For an injury claim, the disability percentage and whether it is permanent are pleaded.

source.ref: Raj Kumar v. Ajay Kumar (assessment of disability)

entries.averment: Where the policy was invalid/lapsed on the accident date, the claim addresses it and proceeds against the owner and driver.
Where income is asserted without documentary proof, the computation records that it proceeds on the asserted figure, to be established at trial.

source.ref: income to be proved at trial
